style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 2 3ft Prelit Tabletop Christmas Trees With Led Lights
style.toneOfVoice: Christmas spirit, doubled with this set of two 3ft prelit christmas trees. With snow-brushed tips, red berries and pine cones, the trees are already dressed and can be set up how they arrive; add your own decorations for a personal touch. Each Christmas tree with lights gently illuminates your space, looking beautiful in the dark. Set up is easy too, taking about ten minutes, you just need to shape the branches into place.<br>&nbsp;- Set of two 3ft LED christmas trees. Use together or individually;<br>&nbsp;- Battery operated LED lights: 18-hours on, six-hours off timer;<br>&nbsp;- Snow-brushed branches with red berries and pine cones: a beautiful seasonal look;<br>&nbsp;- Flame retardant branches enhance safety. Tough plastic to use this year and following seasons;<br>&nbsp;- Single-section design. Just shape the branches, approx. three minutes needed;<br>&nbsp;- Colour: Green;<br>&nbsp;- Light Colour: Warm White;<br>&nbsp;- Material: Plastic, Concrete, Metal;<br>&nbsp;- Overall Dimension: F57 x 90Hcm;<br>&nbsp;- Tree Height: 3ft;<br>&nbsp;- Tip Count: 291;<br>&nbsp;- LED Count: 60;<br>&nbsp;- Cord Length: 0.3(m);<br>&nbsp;- Item Label: 830-920V03GN;<br>&nbsp;Note:;<br>&nbsp;Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;<br>&nbsp;In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get optimal look from the tree, suggest you to take 3 minutes to shape the tree.
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Double the Christmas spirit with this set of two 3ft pre-lit Christmas trees. With snow-brushed tips, red berries and pine cones, the trees are already decorated and can be displayed as they arrive, or you can add your own decorations for a personal touch. Each Christmas tree with lights gently illuminates your space, looking beautiful in the dark. Setup is easy too, taking about ten minutes; you just need to shape the branches into place. Set of two 3ft LED Christmas trees. Use together or individually. Battery-operated LED lights with an 18-hour on, six-hour off timer. Snow-brushed branches with red berries and pine cones for a beautiful seasonal look. Flame-retardant branches enhance safety. Tough plastic construction for use this year and in future seasons. Single-section design. Just shape the branches, with approximately three minutes needed. Colour: Green. Light colour: Warm White. Material: Plastic, Concrete, Metal. Overall dimensions: F57 x 90Hcm. Tree height: 3ft. Tip count: 291. LED count: 60. Cord length: 0.3m. Item label: 830-920V03GN. Note: For indoor use only, not for outdoor use. To achieve a full appearance, spread out all individual tips for the best look. It is recommended to spend three minutes shaping the tree.
